menu:510100328:1.text: Wait, hold on! You can see me? For real?
menu:510100328:1.source_cn: 天哪！您……您能看见我？您真的能看见我？！

say:0:1631150001:0.text: Why does it feel so eerie here...
say:0:1631150001:0.source_cn: 怎么感觉这里阴风阵阵的……

say:1:1631151001:0.text: This is wonderful! Finally, someone who can hear me! I... I don't even know how long I've been stuck here. Years? Decades?
say:1:1631151001:0.source_cn: 太好了！终于有人能听见我说话了！我……我不知道在这里待...

say:2:1631151002:0.text: I know I'm dead, that much is clear. But I was supposed to go somewhere else. Somewhere... bigger. Peaceful. They say it's full of sunflower seeds. Endless sunflower seeds!
say:2:1631151002:0.source_cn: 我死了，这我很清楚，但我本来应该去一个……一个更宽敞的...

say:3:1631151003:0.text: But I'm hopelessly bad with directions! I flew the wrong way and crashed straight into this enormous maze of shelves... and after that, I just couldn't find my way out!
say:3:1631151003:0.source_cn: 可我是个路痴，您明白吗？彻头彻尾的路痴！我飞错了方向，...

say:4:1631151004:1.text: I've tried so many times, but every time I pass through a wall, it's still a room. Still a hallway. I just keep going in circles!
say:4:1631151004:1.source_cn: 我试过很多次，可每次穿过墙壁，外面还是房间，还是走廊！...

say:5:1631151005:1.text: Kind sir... would you... would you help me?
say:5:1631151005:1.male: Kind sir... would you... would you help me?
say:5:1631151005:1.female: Kind ma'am... would you... would you help me?

say:6:1631151006:0.text: I've heard that if you fly out a window filled with a sense of peace, you'll finally find the right path.
say:6:1631151006:0.source_cn: 我听说，只要从一扇充满安宁气息的窗户飞出去，就能找到正...

choice_prompt:7:1631151006.text: I've heard that if you fly out a window filled with a sense of peace, you'll finally find the right path.
choice_prompt:7:1631151006.source_cn: 我听说，只要从一扇充满安宁气息的窗户飞出去，就能找到正确的路了。

say:8:1631151007:0.text: Thank you! Truly, thank you so much!

say:0:1631151501:0.text: A window with a peaceful aura... the lounge window! This way!
say:0:1631151501:0.source_cn: 安宁气息？嗯……那一定是休息室的窗户，跟我来！
say:0:1631151501:0.male: A window with a peaceful aura... the lounge window! This way!
say:0:1631151501:0.female: A window with a peaceful aura... the lounge window! This way!

narration:0:1631152001:1.text: Guided by you, the pigeon's spirit dissolves into a soft glimmer of light, drifting lightly into the sky.
narration:0:1631152001:1.male: Guided by you, the pigeon's spirit dissolves into a soft glimmer of light, drifting lightly into the sky.
narration:0:1631152001:1.female: Guided by you, the pigeon's spirit dissolves into a soft glimmer of light, drifting lightly into the sky.

narration:1:1631152002:1.text: It circles above your head three times, lets out a clear, cheerful coo, and then soars into the depths of the clouds.
narration:1:1631152002:1.male: It circles above your head three times, lets out a clear, cheerful coo, and then soars into the depths of the clouds.
narration:1:1631152002:1.female: It circles above your head three times, lets out a clear, cheerful coo, and then soars into the depths of the clouds.
